comment: No source is published; read from the maker's manual. The module configures 328 parameters, which is four note pools of eight blocks at ten parameters a block plus eight module controls; only the eight blocks of the active pool have widget positions, so the other 24 blocks get no tag. The manual describes eight note pools and a keyboard strip of the same kind as the premium ImprovSr; this build has four (params 4 to 7) and the selection test rejects any value above 4.99V.
